_doc: KXPOKEMON event -> the TCGplayer product its Collectr price mirrors (pokemon_fair.py).
Keyed by EVENT: Kalshi reuses codes across months (26SEPCHA was Charmander, 26OCTCHA is Charizard).
item = the name in the market's rules ('Ungraded Price of the <item> on Collectr'); a mismatch stands the event aside.
tcgplayer_id = Collectr's catalog id = TCGplayer's product id. printing = TCGplayer pricepoints printingType (Foil for holo cards, Normal for sealed).
kind = card | sealed (picks the model's drift and sigma). Re-read on change: no bot restart needed.
New month: python pokemon_fair.py --suggest lists TCGplayer candidates for the unmapped events; check the strike against the item's price at listing.
